title: QUESTIONNAIRES — Blood Donation
description: Whether the donor was told they had low haemoglobin at donation, and how they felt after giving blood, from the questionnaire.
$comment: The source gives no 999 for these items.

haemLow.title: In the last 6 months have you been told by a member of NHSBT staff at your blood donation that you have low haemoglobin levels?

feel_after.title: Immediately after giving blood how do you feel physically compared to how you usually feel?
